reviews.title: Question
reviews.text:
Love the game; been playing for years but I’m confused about something.  Since the newest update whenever I open the game and choose “resume” assuming it will pick up where I left off the night before, all the cards except for 2 near the top are face down.  I can’t play those cards and have to close out the game and choose “new game” and then I lose my progress from the day before.  
Why are those 2 random cards face up and why can’t I play them?
Also, why is the card at the top of the pyramid colored yellow?
Also, the sun moving across the top of the pyramid is distracting.
Can you please address and explain.  Thank you.

reviews.title: Great game play
reviews.text: The only game I’ve had on my phone since. Day one! Their card randomization routine is a little too easy easy, when a double exist on the tableau, you almost always get a double in the draw!! Way too often. In reality playing this game with an actual deck of cards would rarely get you 1012 even 16 rounds clearing the entire table. But this is quite frequent. I’m not saying it would be better if it was more realistically Random, it’s still fun to play but I have to laugh. If this game was in Vegas you’d be rich.

reviews.title: Fun game to play
reviews.text:
Animation needs to be faster and the high score needs to change when you bust out and not keep it as an accumulation of the score so you get a true high score. Animation is cool and the game is fun. I would rather see records for most games won in a row since high score is not a true score.

Update:  after a quick response from glowing eye I found out it’s a simple change to in the main menu to remove the continuation of points. I still would like to see the animation move a little quicker but the graphics are very cool so I am being picky 

Thanks for the quick response!

reviews.title: Van2goe
reviews.text: This game is highly addictive and I do mean addictive. This is my all time favorite solitary game. Many have come but non to match. Above the rest, Pyramid Solitaire keeps me coming back to play several times daily. Excellent game if you love solitaire. Still my favorite game of Solitaire. Say I'm addicted and you would be on point. Played many years and still can't get enough. After the last 5 years and still counting, Pyramid Solitaire remains my No.1 solitaire game. It has to be good to make me play so much throughout the day. Pyramid Solitaire, one of the best. What more can I say? This is an excellent game of Solitaire that will keep you coming back daily. Still No.1.
